skill.summary: Headless browser automation CLI optimized for AI agents with accessibility tree snapshots and ref-based element selection

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial public release of the agent-browser skill.

- Provides CLI for fast, headless browser automation with accessibility tree snapshots and ref-based element selection.
- Supports deterministic, multi-step workflows, session isolation, and state saving/loading.
- Includes commands for navigation, element interaction, network control, cookies/storage, tabs/frames, and taking snapshots/screenshots.
- Optimized for performance and working with complex SPAs; best used when deterministic automation is needed.
- Comprehensive SKILL.md documentation included with usage examples and best practices.
